title: Home
description: Saves a home position for when the entity is spawned. This component allows entities like bees to remember and return to a specific location such as a hive or nest.

home_block_list.description: Optional list of blocks that can be considered a valid home.

restriction_radius.description: Optional radius that the entity will be restricted to in relation to its home.

restriction_type.description: Defines how the entity will be restricted to its home position.
